paper.title: Interferometric Single-Shot Parity Measurement in InAs-Al Hybrid Devices

result.summary: 本文在 InAs-Al 异质结门定义纳米线中实现了对费米子宇称的单次干涉测量，作为测量型拓扑量子计算的一步 [abstract]。器件由三量子点干涉仪与近藤纳米线隧穿耦合构成，通过色散栅极探测量子电容来读取宇称 [S2.p3]。测量显示量子电容随磁通呈 h/2e 周期双峰分布，最优磁通下 3.7 µs 内信噪比为 1 [abstract]，并观测到两个宇称态之间的随机电报信号，驻留时间约 2 ms [S3.p3]。作者将这些结果解释为两端相距约 3 µm 的 Majorana 零能模所编码的费米子宇称测量，且非平衡准粒子中毒率较低 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是实现对一维拓扑超导体中 Majorana 零能模所编码的费米子宇称的投影测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，量子信息存储在纳米线两端 MZMs 的费米子宇称中，投影测量用于处理量子信息和读取量子比特状态 [S1.p2]。本文的目标是演示对一维纳米线中近零能态宇称的干涉测量，从而验证拓扑量子计算的一个必要要素 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.

Quantum information is stored in the fermion parity of Majorana zero modes (MZMs) localized at the ends of superconducting wires, and projective measurements of the fermion parity are used to process quantum information and perform qubit state readout.
In this paper, we demonstrate an interferometric measurement of the parity of a near-zero-energy state in a 1D nanowire, thereby validating a necessary ingredient of topological quantum computation.

method.text: 作者提出并实现了一种基于色散栅极探测三量子点干涉仪（TQDI）的读出方案：三个量子点与一维拓扑超导体构成一个被磁通穿过的回路，通过测量中间量子点（dot 2）的量子电容来读取宇称 [S2.p3]。器件使用门控超导体-半导体异质结，其中 InAs 量子阱厚 9.1 nm，Al 条宽 60 nm、厚 6.5 nm [S2.p1]。作者还建立了包含 MZMs、三个量子点和环境耦合的有效模型，并用量子动力学模拟（含射频驱动功率、电荷噪声和温度）来复现实验结果 [S3.p4][S3.p6]。

evidence.quote: Our readout circuit is based on dispersive gate sensing of a triple quantum dot interferometer (TQDI): three electrostatically defined quantum dots that together with the 1DTS form a loop threaded by a flux, $\Phi$
The active region of the semiconductor consists of a $9.1\text{\,}\mathrm{nm}$ thick InAs quantum well with a $6\text{\,}\mathrm{nm}$ thick In 0.88 Al 0.12 As top barrier
The superconductor is a $60\text{\,}\mathrm{nm}$ wide Al strip (blue in Figs. 1 and 2) deposited with a thickness of $6.5\text{\,}\mathrm{nm}$ on the semiconductor.
We support this interpretation by reproducing our results with quantum dynamics simulations that incorporate rf drive power, charge noise, and temperature.

For detailed comparison with experiments, we simulate a more complete model of our interferometer, expanded to include the full triple-dot system, incoherent coupling to the environment, and backaction from the measurement.

experiments.text: 实验在器件 A 和器件 B 上进行，测量了量子电容随垂直磁场 B⊥（控制磁通）和 dot 2 栅压的变化 [S3.p1][S3.p11]。作者使用约 1.5×10^4 次连续测量、每次积分时间 4.5 µs，记录总长 67 ms 的时间轨迹，并以 0.14 mT 步长扫描 B⊥ [S3.p1]。在器件 A 中，相关参数区间位于 B∥=1.8 T 和 V_WP1=-1.832 V 附近 [S3.p2]。作者还进行了三项对照实验：注入准粒子、将量子点与纳米线断开、以及在 0.8 T 的低场（平庸相）下重复测量 [S3.p12][S3.p13][S3.p14]。

evidence.quote: we tune up the TQDI and perform a sequence of nearly $1.5\times 10^{4}$ consecutive measurements of the resonator response, each with an integration time of $4.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$, thereby recording a time trace of total length $67\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$

We sweep the out-of-plane magnetic field $B_{\perp}$ in steps of $0.14\text{\,}\mathrm{mT}$ to study the dependence on the external flux $\Phi$ through the interferometer loop and sweep $V_{{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle QD}2}}$ to find charge transitions in dot 2.
For device A, the relevant regime is in the neighborhood of $B_{\parallel}=$1.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$$ and $V_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle WP1}}=$-1.832\text{\,}\mathrm{V}$$.
The reproducibility of the observed phenomena is demonstrated in Sec. S6.1, where we discuss a second measurement (A2) on device A ( Fig. S8) and a measurement of device B ( Fig. S9).
First, we investigate the impact of injecting quasiparticles into the superconductor as indicated in Fig. 5 a
Our second control experiment is to completely disconnect the dots from the wire.

Finally, we repeat the interferometry measurement at a low field ( $0.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$), where the device is well within the trivial phase, and the induced gap in the nanowire has not closed yet.

findings.text: 量子电容测量显示随磁通呈 h/2e 周期的双峰分布，最优磁通下 3.7 µs 内信噪比为 1 [abstract]。在双峰出现的磁通值处，时间轨迹呈现随机电报信号，两个态之间的驻留时间约 2 ms [S3.p3]。作者将这些 h/2e 周期双峰振荡和随机电报信号解释为费米子宇称的切换 [S3.p3]。模拟得到的最大 ΔC_Q 约 1 fF，与测量值接近 [S3.p7]。准粒子注入实验使 τ_RTS 从 0 到 90 µV 偏压时降至一半，而 ΔC_Q 对偏压依赖较弱 [S3.p12]。在 0.8 T 低场下未观察到 h/e 磁通周期性，与有能隙纳米线的预期一致 [S3.p14]。

evidence.quote: Our quantum capacitance measurements show flux h / 2 ​ e h/2e -periodic bimodality with a signal-to-noise ratio of 1 1 in 3.7 µ ​ s 3.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s} at optimal flux values.
The time evolution of ${\tilde{C}}_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ exhibits a random telegraph signal (RTS) at flux values where there is negative kurtosis
the intervals between switches follow an exponential distribution with a characteristic time $\tau_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle RTS}}\approx$2\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$$
We interpret these $h/2e$ -periodic bimodal oscillations and RTS in ${\tilde{C}}_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ as originating from switches of fermion parity.

our simulations yield an estimated maximum value as a function of flux $\Delta C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}\approx$1\text{\,}\mathrm{fF}$$, which is close to the measured value shown in Fig. 3 f-h.

$\tau_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle RTS}}$ decreases to half of its value as the bias voltage is increased from $0$ to $90\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro V}$, while $\Delta C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ exhibits weak dependence on bias voltage.
we do not observe any $h/e$ flux periodicity as expected for a gapped wire

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，该测量本身不能明确区分拓扑相中的 MZMs 和平庸相中精细调节的低能 Andreev 束缚态 [S1.p3]。作者也承认，这些测量本身不能确定干涉测量探测到的低能态是否是拓扑的 [S5.p1]。此外，作者指出在准 Majorana 情景中，当隐藏 Majorana 模之间及其与 MZMs 的耦合较弱时，量子电容信号会被显著抑制，与测量值不一致 [S3.p15]。作者还提到，在当前器件中，由于有限尺寸效应，预期 E_M 会有显著变化，且拓扑能隙和相干长度并非远小于器件长度 [S4.p7]。

evidence.quote: By itself, this measurement does not unequivocally distinguish between MZMs in the topological phase and fine-tuned low-energy Andreev bound states in the trivial phase
These measurements do not, by themselves, determine whether the low-energy states detected by interferometry are topological.

We find that when these “hidden” Majorana modes are weakly coupled to each other and to other MZMs, the quantum capacitance signal is significantly suppressed, to a degree that is inconsistent with the measured values.
in the current generation of devices, we anticipate modest energy gaps $\Delta_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle T}}$ and coherence lengths that are not significantly smaller than the device length.
